SELECT count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{purchase,order_purchased}'))) AS "buyers" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') AND ("e"."ep" -> 'device' ->> 'type') = 'desktop' LIMIT 1001

SELECT count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{purchase,order_purchased}'))) AS "buyers" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') AND ("e"."ep" -> 'campaign' ->> 'channel') = 'email' LIMIT 1001

SELECT count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{purchase,order_purchased}'))) AS "buyers" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') AND "e"."item_category" = 'home' LIMIT 1001

SELECT * FROM (SELECT "e"."item_category" AS "item_category", coalesce(sum("e"."revenue") FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{purchase,order_purchased}'))), 0) AS "revenue" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') GROUP BY 1) q ORDER BY "revenue" DESC NULLS LAST, "item_category" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ("e"."ep" -> 'device' ->> 'type') AS "device_type", count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{purchase,order_purchased}'))) AS "buyers" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') GROUP BY 1) q ORDER BY "buyers" DESC NULLS LAST, "device_type" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ("e"."ep" -> 'campaign' ->> 'channel') AS "campaign_channel", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{view,cart,remove_from_cart,purchase,order_purchased,order_approved,order_shipped,order_delivered,order_canceled,payment_made,review_submitted}'))) AS "events" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') GROUP BY 1) q ORDER BY "events" DESC NULLS LAST, "campaign_channel" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

SELECT * FROM (SELECT "e"."item_category" AS "item_category", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.event_name = ANY('{purchase,order_purchased}'))) AS "purchases" FROM analytics.event_activity e JOIN analytics.source_registry sr ON sr.source_id = e.source_id WHERE e.source_id = ANY('{event_benchmark}') GROUP BY 1) q ORDER BY "purchases" DESC NULLS LAST, "item_category" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2
